sources.name: schedule
sources.argHint: a market slug, e.g. austin. The checked-in fixture is synthetic (fictional theaters and films) but structurally faithful, so expect every value to differ — compare shapes and key names, not content.

sources.name: seats
sources.argHint: cinemaId/sessionId of a live on-sale reserved-seating session, taken from a current schedule feed (sessions age out). The checked-in fixture is synthetic, so again compare shape, not content.
